samir_runtime: Ran an nsys capture on staging after the recent batching heuristic tweak. timeline shows repeated hotspots in a few kernels during kv-cache lookups and attention matmul. attaching quick notes.

maria_perf: which nsys flags did you use? and did you include NVTX ranges? :eyes:

samir_runtime: `nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx --output=run1` then `nsys nvprof --stats` (we use the CI wrapper). NVTX ranges are sparse right now so it was noisy.

elaine_ml: can you paste the kernel timeline snippet? even a short list of top kernels helps.

samir_runtime: top kernels by GPU time: \n  - attention_fused_gemm (40%)\n  - kv_cache_read (22%)\n  - small_matmul_16x16 (12%)\n  - softmax_kernel (8%)\n  - kv_cache_write (6%)\n

jonah: hm small_matmul_16x16 at 12% is suspicious — that's usually triggered by small batch inference or wrong kernel selection for quantized path.

maria_perf: did the kernel selector pick a fallback for some layers? timeline spikes align with when batch sizes drop to 1-2.

samir_runtime: yes, the new heuristic that caps max_batch_wait_ms to 8ms reduced batch packing for short tails. I think we hit a regression where small matrices use low-throughput kernels.

elaine_ml: we should add denser NVTX ranges to disambiguate: separate ranges for "batch_collect", "kv_read(layer=N)", "kv_write(layer=N)", "decode_step". that will let nsys map CUDA kernels to logical spans.

maria_perf: naming convention proposal: `RUNTIME:<reqid_prefix>:<stage>:layer<N>` e.g. `RUNTIME:0x3fa:KV:layer4` — short hex of req id keeps strings small.

jonah: +1 for short ids. keep labels <= 64 chars for NVTX. also avoid expensive sprintf in hot loops.

samir_runtime: implementation note: we can use the RAII helper `NVTXRange r(fmt::format("RUNTIME:{:x}:KV:L{}", id_hash, l));` but only enabled in perf builds. otherwise no-op.

maria_perf: important: avoid pushing NVTX ranges inside inner GEMM loops—NVTX calls have overhead. push around higher-level ops (kv read/write per layer, attention forward/backwards if possible).

elaine_ml: for per-request spans we should correlate req id to color via `nvtxNameCategoryA`? nsys supports colors via `nvtxRangeId` + attributes. we can hash id -> color on range creation.

jonah: also consider grouping ranges by request-class (inference vs generation) not every token for streaming calls. too many ranges floods nsys UI.

samir_runtime: agreed. planned instrumentation: \n  - push range at batch formation: `BATCH:<batch_id>`\n  - per-request short range at decode start: `REQ:<h>` (only for slow or sampled requests)\n  - per-layer kv read/write: `KV:L#` (no req id)\n  - attention overall: `ATTN:L#`\n

maria_perf: sampling is key. instrument all ranges in internal perf builds; in prod builds only sample 1/1000 requests to avoid overhead.

elaine_ml: small code snippet for low-cost tagging: ```c++
#ifdef PERF_NVTX
struct ScopedRange { nvtxRangeId_t id; ScopedRange(const char* s){ nvtxRangePushA(s);} ~ScopedRange(){ nvtxRangePop(); } };
#else
struct ScopedRange{ ScopedRange(const char*){} };
#endif
```
Use with `ScopedRange r("BATCH:12");`

jonah: from profiler side: run `nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx --sample=cpu  --output=bbox` then open in perfetto for timeline + GPU kernel view. also `nsys stats` for kernel summaries.

opsbot: perf-alert: recent deploy 2025-07-19 02:41 UTC increased p95 token latency by 12% on xlarge models. correlates with batching change. (automated)

samir_runtime: linking the nsys capture: https://perf.example.com/runs/7342 (contains timeline and flamegraphs). focus on period 00:00:12-00:00:18 where small_matmul spikes.

maria_perf: proposed short-term fix: restore previous max_batch_wait_ms for heavy models, and add a flow that forces kernel selector to prefer large-matmul kernels when sequence_len>1024 or qkv_size>64.

elaine_ml: long-term: better heuristics: sample profiler every N deploys to recompute kernel-choice boundaries, and add unit tests that run micro-benchmarks for quantized paths.

samir_runtime: I'll open a PR for NVTX helper + sampling toggle. also a perf job that runs nsys capture in CI for the canary cluster.

jonah: action items: samir -> PR for ranges + sampling; maria -> run local reproducer and test kernel selector patch; elaine -> update eval to include micro-benchmarks. target EOD for patch rollout.

maria_perf: thanks! will post results in this thread when I have the reproducer ready. :thumbsup:

opsbot: note: remember to redact any sensitive links before posting publicly.

samir_runtime: noted. I'll keep captures internal. closing loop once PRs land.
